request.label: outlet-campaign-cp3-parity-publish
command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$1"
archive='evidence/outlet-campaign-cp3-parity.tar.gz'
test ! -e "$archive"
for item in 'evidence/outlet-campaign-extent-runtime.json' 'evidence/outlet-campaign-x15-parity.json' 'evidence/outlet-Bp1-audit.json' 'evidence/outlet-Bp1-audit-inlet.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-Bp1-Bf.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-bp1-admission.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-bp1-forecast.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-be1-forecast.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-be1-forecast-v2.json' 'operations/outlet-campaign-extent-stage/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-campaign-extent-configure/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-campaign-extent-build/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-campaign-extent-bind/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-campaign-bp1-phase-forecast/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bp1-admission/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bp1-audit/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bp1-compare/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bp1-inputs/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-qual-bp1-steady/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-campaign-extent-parity/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-campaign-be1-phase-forecast/receipt.json' 'operations/outlet-campaign-be1-phase-forecast-v2/receipt.json'; do test -f "$item"; done
temporary="$archive.work-$$"
trap 'rm -f -- "$temporary"' EXIT
tar -I 'gzip -1' -cf "$temporary" 'evidence/outlet-campaign-extent-runtime.json' 'evidence/outlet-campaign-x15-parity.json' 'evidence/outlet-Bp1-audit.json' 'evidence/outlet-Bp1-audit-inlet.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-Bp1-Bf.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-bp1-admission.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-bp1-forecast.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-be1-forecast.json' 'evidence/outlet-qual-be1-forecast-v2.json' 'operations/outlet-campaign-extent-stage' 'operations/outlet-campaign-extent-configure' 'operations/outlet-campaign-extent-build' 'operations/outlet-campaign-extent-bind' 'operations/outlet-campaign-bp1-phase-forecast' 'operations/outlet-qual-bp1-admission' 'operations/outlet-qual-bp1-audit' 'operations/outlet-qual-bp1-compare' 'operations/outlet-qual-bp1-inputs' 'operations/outlet-qual-bp1-steady' 'operations/outlet-campaign-extent-parity' 'operations/outlet-campaign-be1-phase-forecast' 'operations/outlet-campaign-be1-phase-forecast-v2' 'tools/outlet-campaign-drivers/extent-build.sh' 'tools/outlet-campaign-drivers/extent-build.log' 'tools/outlet-campaign-drivers/extent-build.exit' 'tools/outlet-campaign-drivers/bp1.sh' 'tools/outlet-campaign-drivers/bp1.log' 'tools/outlet-campaign-drivers/bp1.exit' 'tools/outlet-python-v45/h27/task2_outlet_campaign_extent.py' 'accounting.json'
tar -tzf "$temporary" >/dev/null
mv -- "$temporary" "$archive"
stat -c '%n %s' "$archive"

request.label: outlet-campaign-extent-bind
command:
mkdir "$(dirname "$3")"
cp "$2/IncNavierStokesSolver" "$3"
sha256sum "$3"
ldd "$3"
python3 -B "$4" "$1" seal "$5"

request.label: outlet-campaign-extent-stage
command:
git -C "$NEKTAR_SOURCE" status --porcelain; git -C "$NEKTAR_SOURCE" rev-parse HEAD
printf "Published code %s\n" "$4"
mkdir "$2"
cp -a "$1/source-outlet-v1/." "$2/"
tar -xf "$3" -C "$2"
sha256sum "$3"
cd "$2"
shift 4
sha256sum "$@"
